listenings.text: Thank you for calling Rock Creek Family Medicine. Please listen carefully, because our menu has changed. If this is a medical emergency, hang up now and dial nine one one. To schedule, cancel or move an appointment, press one. To reach the billing office about a co-pay, a statement, or a question about your coverage, press two. If you need to refill a prescription, press three, and please have the bottle in front of you, because we'll need the name of the medicine and the number on the label. Refill requests take two business days, so don't wait until the last pill. If you're a new patient, press four. New patients should arrive fifteen minutes early with an insurance card and a photo ID. Our office hours are eight to five, Monday through Friday, and eight to noon on Saturday. To hear this menu again, press nine.

So, my first appointment here. Honestly, I got almost everything wrong. I thought I could walk in and see whoever was free, you know, the way I always did back home. It doesn't work like that. The first thing they asked me was the name of my primary care physician, and I didn't have one, so they booked me for the following week instead. Then at the desk they asked me for forty dollars before I had even seen anybody. That's the co-pay, and nobody had explained that to me. I mean, the visit itself was fine. She listened, she asked about every symptom, she wanted to run two tests. What I should have asked before I went was what my coverage actually included. Three weeks later a bill arrived for the lab work, and that was another two hundred dollars I was not expecting.

This is a short recording about how your plan works. Your plan covers one annual physical, most office visits with your primary care physician, and generic prescriptions, with a co-pay each time. A visit to a specialist, so a dermatologist, an orthopedist, anybody like that, requires a referral from your primary care physician before you go. Without that referral the visit may not be covered, and you would pay the full amount yourself. If you pay out of pocket for something the plan covers, send us the receipt within ninety days. Reimbursement usually takes three to four weeks. And if a bill looks wrong, if you were charged twice, or charged for a follow-up that was already included, please don't pay it. Call the number on the back of your card and ask for an itemized statement first.
